description: Monotonicity / TVD gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 test tvd_monotone of problems/advection_1d_periodic_superbee.esm (model AdvectionSuperbeeTVD) at the default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. The tent profile is advected at c=1; the assertions bound the state's max (no overshoot), min (no undershoot), and mean (exact conservation) — the sim-expressible form of the TVD claim. Assertions and tolerances live in the problem file; this manifest routes runners.
